basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer from Calgary, Canada, who balances a love for gaming with a career in software development. Having recently embraced parenting, I often find myself delving into Lego sets with my little one during weekends. I'm a night owl, usually online after 9 PM local time. Been married for 10 years and enjoy sharing gaming tips and tech insights with fellow enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science from the University of Calgary, I've spent over a decade in software development. My passion for technology and gaming has driven me to stay updated with the latest trends in these areas, often engaging in self-learning through online courses and tech blogs.
